findings.title: Eviction can remove the segment root
findings.body: The size cap evicts members solely by their end-timestamp score. If the root span has an earlier score than the 1,000 retained spans, `zpopmin` removes it while the root marker remains set. The buffer will then flush the remaining spans using the root span ID as their segment ID, but without emitting the root payload, producing an incomplete and misleading segment.

findings.title: Existing Redis sets are incompatible with the new sorted-set commands
findings.body: This changes buffer keys from Redis sets to sorted sets, but existing keys written by the previous version remain alive until their TTL expires. During a rolling deploy, `zadd` on one of those set keys raises `WRONGTYPE`; the Lua script also now uses sorted-set commands on keys that may still be sets. Processing can therefore fail for up to the buffer TTL after deployment. Use a migration/versioned key scheme or handle old keys before switching types.

findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: This implementation assumes the ordering key is numeric, but the audit-log endpoint passes `order_by="-datetime"`. `math.floor()` cannot accept a `datetime`, so building cursors for non-empty results raises `TypeError`; the corresponding cursor value conversion also returns an integer instead of a datetime. The opt-in optimized audit-log request therefore fails instead of returning a page.

findings.title: Negative offsets are rejected by Django queryset slicing
findings.body: The advanced path passes a negative start index into a Django queryset slice. Django does not support negative queryset indices or slices and raises `ValueError` rather than interpreting them as reverse offsets. A request with a negative cursor offset therefore fails instead of providing the advertised bidirectional pagination.
